prompt: All IQly test-takers who finish in under 5 minutes see a speed badge. Dana saw a speed badge. Priya did not see a speed badge. Which must be true?

options.text: Priya finished in 5 minutes or more.
Dana and Priya finished at the same time.
Dana finished in 5 minutes or more.

explanation: The rule is one-directional (under 5 min -> badge), so seeing a badge doesn't prove the time, but NOT seeing a badge proves the condition failed: Priya did not finish under 5 minutes.
